name: Lovira Local Brain Intent Dataset
purpose: Local-first intent classification before LLM fallback
designRules: Local rules never execute arbitrary JavaScript or DOM operations.
App actions must still pass AppActionValidator and AppActionEngine.
Reminder creation delegates date/time parsing to parseVietnameseReminderText.
In-session semantic completion delegates to existing localIntentEngine/actionEngine.
Low-confidence or close competing intents go to clarification/AI fallback.
Negative examples are first-class blockers against false-positive actions.
